last_cycle_basis: jobs.py history has zero WWT/World Wide Technology entries
evidence: WWT's early-in-career track is the Associate Academy / Associate Consulting Systems Engineer (ACSE) program (wwt.com/community/acse/about): a 12-month pre-sales/technical-consultant program, explicitly sales-engineering, not software engineering, and excluded by the skill's 'what counts' rule; its page shows only a waitlist ('Get on the list here'), no open requisition. The ADP-hosted job board (myjobs.adp.com/wwtexternalcareersite) returns the same unfiltered ~335 US listings regardless of keyword searched (UI keyword box and q= URL param both ignored); a manual scan of the top ~20 by-recency listings found only experienced/clearance-required roles (Sr. Systems Engineer, Senior Project Manager, Cyber Security Sales Specialist), no entry-level SWE title.
